bagPolicy.summary: MVP Arena allows clear bags no larger than 12” x 6” x 12” and small clutch bags no larger than 4.5” x 6.5”. Larger bags are prohibited and there is no storage for them.
allowed: CLEAR plastic, vinyl or PVC bags no larger than 12” x 6” x 12”
Small clutch bags no larger than 4.5” x 6.5”
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags are allowed and subject to search.

parking.note: MVP Arena offers a parking garage located behind and attached to the venue, accessible via Market St., with rates starting at $8 daily. Parking is first come, first served, and availability is not guaranteed. Street parking is typically available on nights and weekends.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by MVP Arena. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.note: MVP Arena is a cashless facility where concessions accept cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Outside food and beverages are prohibited.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is available by request through the MVP Arena Box Office during normal business hours (M-F 10am-4pm) by calling (866) 308-3394.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in MVP Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Any change to standard hours will be posted on our Box Office Hours page.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: If you park in the MVP Arena Parking Garage, use the arena entrance on level 3. Door times are posted on each event page, sometimes closer to the show date.
